purpose: Add exactly one response-blind spatial co-opportunity control to the nested C1 historical-information conditioning set, so historical information loss can be localized to geography without reopening relational v0.3.

geographic_opportunity.radius_inheritance: Inherited from the prospectively frozen B/C spatial-opportunity scale; not selected using C1 or C2 outputs.
geographic_opportunity.measure: For each directed source-target dyad, the fraction of target response-blind occurrence coordinates whose nearest source occurrence coordinate is within 500 km great-circle distance.
geographic_opportunity.reason: TTF-Q characterizes information continuously rather than declaring low-overlap dyads failed.

nested_information_decomposition.C1_total_unique_fraction: historical relation variance surviving source/target identity and C1 controls
nested_information_decomposition.C2_total_unique_fraction: historical relation variance surviving source/target identity and C1 controls plus geographic co-opportunity
nested_information_decomposition.interpretation: This localizes how much history-specific relational information was spatial co-opportunity in disguise. It is not a test of a genetic-transfer effect.
